continuitySourceGapPolicy: Categories without Stage 1 source text are source-gap/candidate-only; Type Lumina names/mentions without source stay candidate-only.
candidatePolicy: Do not formalize missing cast from mentions only. Search/read direct source entries first in a later stage; if absent, keep candidate-only source gaps.
appearancePolicy: Missing cast appearance must not be inferred; direct profile or not-found/source-gap only.
outfitEquipmentPolicy: Equipment must remain absent unless directly sourced.
abilityActivationPolicy: Abilities such as Mystic Eyes, Dead Apostle powers, maid/Tohno abilities require direct source lines.
combatEffectPolicy: Combat roles from route summaries remain candidate-only until direct extraction.
relationshipPolicy: Mentioned relations can seed search terms, not formal edges.
timelinePolicy: Use mention contexts as search anchors only; no timeline facts from unsourced memory.
notFoundPolicy: Record source-gap or not-found-in-source for candidates lacking direct profile text.
forbidden: formal cast completion from model memory
gateCriteria: no formal facts for missing cast
source gaps visible for next stage
